scientific_integrity: The analytic argument proves uniform bounds for all finite dimensions; finite checker instances are supplemental. Literature comparisons include a residual risk of unindexed graph retraction results.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant applies only to compatible point retractions on finite full Hamming boxes, not unrestricted Schauder bases, arbitrary metric subsets, or infinite products. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
title: Sharp retractional basis constants of finite Hamming boxes
